profiles.label: Shopify orders
profiles.guidance: For line-level Proofs, use a report with OrderNumber, LineId, SourceRevision, Quantity and UOM on each row. Shopify’s standard order CSV omits a stable line ID and revision.

profiles.label: Microsoft Dynamics 365 sales order lines
profiles.guidance: Use one company per folder. Include its DataAreaId and either an increasing SourceRevision or a ReportAsOf timestamp with a time zone on every line.

profiles.label: Odoo 18 sales order lines
profiles.guidance: Export confirmed sales order lines for one company. Use external IDs for the order, line and company. Include either an increasing SourceRevision or a ReportAsOf timestamp with a time zone on every line.

profiles.label: Enterprise Shipper daily shipping report
profiles.guidance: To link shipments to orders, use a report with OrderNumber, ShipmentID and SourceRevision. Then confirm which order source supplied those order numbers.
